places.title: Cape Hatteras
places.text: The Gulf Stream leaves the coast here and heads out to sea as a meandering jet.

places.title: Florida Straits
places.text: The current squeezes between Florida and the Bahamas before running north.

trend.note: Jan 1 to Sep 28 of each year, compared with the 1991-2020 average

places.title: Agulhas Current
places.text: Warm Indian Ocean water runs south-west along the coast of South Africa.

places.title: Retroflection
places.text: The current turns back east on itself. Rings pinch off here and drift into the Atlantic.

trend.note: Jan 1 to Sep 28 of each year, compared with the 1991-2020 average

places.title: Leaving Japan
places.text: The Kuroshio leaves the coast near Tokyo and becomes a free eastward jet.

places.title: Kuroshio Extension
places.text: The jet meanders east for thousands of kilometres, shedding eddies to both sides.

trend.note: Jan 1 to Sep 28 of each year, compared with the 1991-2020 average

places.title: The Confluence
places.text: Warm Brazil Current water meets the cold Malvinas (Falklands) Current head-on.

places.title: Río de la Plata
places.text: One of the world's largest estuaries spills fresh river water onto the shelf.

trend.note: Jan 1 to Sep 28 of each year, compared with the 1991-2020 average
